headline.gap: Snapshots are not contiguous, so no single instruction can be blamed
headline.multi: This action may have executed several instructions; only measured differences are shown
headline.push: push: RSP moved down by 8 bytes
headline.pop: pop: RSP moved up by 8 bytes
headline.mov: mov: observe the measured register/memory change
headline.stackPointer: {{mnemonic}} rsp: the stack pointer moved by the immediate
headline.call: call: pushed a return address and jumped
headline.ret: ret: took the return address from the stack top

lines.waiting: After one instruction, a before/after-based explanation appears here.
lines.gap1: The snapshot's previous_snapshot_id does not match the locally stored previous snapshot.
lines.gap2: Only measured differences are shown; wait for contiguous snapshots to explain the instruction.
lines.multi1: Finish/Continue/launch are not single instructions; before/after differences cannot be attributed to one instruction.
lines.noInstruction: The snapshot did not provide an instruction to explain.
lines.pushDecreased: RSP decreased by 8 bytes, so the stack grew toward lower addresses.
lines.pushNewQword: The 8 bytes at the new RSP are {{value}}.
lines.pushMatchesSource: That value equals {{register}} before the push ({{value}}).
lines.pushUnexpected: The measured RSP delta for push is {{delta}}, not the expected -8.
lines.popOldQword: The 8 bytes at RSP before the pop were {{value}}.
lines.popUnexpected: The measured RSP delta for pop is {{delta}}, not the expected +8.
lines.movBytes: {{count}} byte(s) changed inside this snapshot window.
lines.stackPointerDelta: RSP changed by {{delta}}, matching the immediate in the instruction.
lines.stackPointerNoFrame: This is RSP arithmetic; it does not mean the space between RSP and RBP is all local variables.
lines.stackPointerMismatch: The RSP delta does not match the instruction's immediate, so no frame semantics were applied.
lines.callJumped: RSP decreased by 8 bytes; RIP jumped to {{target}}.
lines.callReturnConfirmed: [RSP] is {{value}}, which equals the address of the instruction after call: a return address.
lines.callReturnUnconfirmed: [RSP] is {{value}}; it was not confirmed to be the return address.
lines.callUnexpected: The measured RSP delta for call is {{delta}}, not the expected -8.
lines.retOldQword: The 8 bytes read from the old RSP are {{value}}.
lines.retConfirmed: That value equals the new RIP, measured as the return address.
lines.retUnexpected: The measured RSP delta for ret is {{delta}}, not the expected +8.
lines.leaveMechanism: RSP was set to the old RBP and then increased by 8 (equivalent to mov rsp,rbp; pop rbp).
lines.leaveRestored: RBP was measured restored to [old RBP] = {{value}}.
lines.leaveNoFrameBase: Only measured register changes are stated; the old RBP is not assumed to be a fixed frame base.
lines.leaveUnexpected: The measured RSP/RBP changes do not match the usual leave shape.
lines.nopQuiet: No register changed and no byte changed inside the snapshot window.
lines.nopRipUnclear: RIP did not advance in a straight line; check the disassembly view.
lines.nopUnexpected: nop was observed with register or memory changes, so nop semantics were not applied.
lines.unknownMnemonic: No semantic explanation is generated for {{mnemonic}}; observe registers, stack and diff.
